about:
# Animal Facts

A simple dumb addon that allows you to say / yell / raid warning a random animal fact

Main command:

/af  OR /animalfact 

Command Options:

s: Sends an animal fact to the /say channel.

p: Sends an animal fact to the /party channel.

ra: Sends an animal fact to the /raid channel.

rw: Sends an animal fact to the /raidwarning channel.

g: Sends an animal to the /guild channel.

i or bg: Sends an animal fact to /instance or /bg channel.

w or t whispers an animal fact to your current target

r whispers an animal fact to your last reply. Or you can start a new whisper and type /af r to send them an animal fact

You can also use the numbers 1 through 5 to send a bird fact to global channels (Depends on the order of your channels)

You can also use /af to send facts about that animal to the default channel.
Animal choices are: cat, dog, frog, bird, raccoon, generic

Example usage:

/af p: Birds have wings!

Have a fact you'd like to add or have issues? Visit discord.gg/AqGTbYMgtK

# AnimalFacts

## [v6.0](https://github.com/awallclock/AnimalFacts/tree/v6.0) (2026-10-11)
[Full Changelog](https://github.com/awallclock/AnimalFacts/compare/v5.0.1...v6.0) [Previous Releases](https://github.com/awallclock/AnimalFacts/releases)

- Bump version to 6.0  
    Update the addon version and simplify the author attribution in the options panel.  
- Load options after fact modules  
    Move Options.lua to the end of the add-on load list so fact modules are loaded first.  
- Bind AnimalFacts as self in options  
- Guard fact counts against missing lists  
    Use empty tables when animal fact lists are nil so the options labels can display safely.  
- Localize the global table in Options.lua  
    Bind `_G` locally before registering the addon table.  
- Localize \_G before addon initialization  
    Move the \_G local declaration to the top of the file so it is available during addon setup.  
- Fix slash command hint and fact count  
    Show the correct `/af opt` command in invalid-command guidance and safely display the generic fact count when `aFacts` is not initialized.  
- Use addon metadata wrapper in options  
    Read the displayed addon version through `AnimalFacts.GetAddOnMetadata`.  
- Add addon options panel  
    The addon manifest now loads Options.lua, enabling the new configuration UI for AnimalFacts. This adds the settings panel so users can configure the addon from the standard interface without needing to edit files manually.  
- Fix chat routing and options opening  
    Route instance chat requests to the instance channel and fix the options command's combat check and settings opener, with support for current and legacy WoW settings APIs.  
- Expose addon config globals  
    Make `AnimalFacts`, `AC`, and `ACD` global, and store the addon metadata lookup on `AnimalFacts` so other files can access them.  
- Fix Lua syntax and format addon files  
    Fix the missing comma between bird facts, add a Eurasian swift fact, and normalize formatting in the addon and options files.  
- Ignore chat commands during combat  
    Return early from chat message handling while in combat, preventing command processing during encounters.  
- Fix options table registration  
    Register the options panel and AceConfig table with the add-on name, and retain the Blizzard category ID.  
- Add repeat avoidance and refresh addon support  
    Add configurable fact-repeat tracking, move settings into Options.lua, expand bird facts, and update the bundled Ace libraries for newer WoW clients.
